subject: GCP private offer: commitment timeline, billing route & procurement checklist
messages:
From: Clare Morris <clare.morris@nimbuslabs.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbuslabs.ai
Date: Thu, 25 Nov 2027 16:08:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Marketplace evaluation & next steps

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the product demo yesterday — really helpful. We want to move from evaluation to a committed private offer on GCP but need a short mutual action plan (MAP) and clarity on the billing path so procurement can route approval.

Key asks from our side:
- A one-page MAP with milestones (PO issuance, private offer acceptance, migration window).
- Confirmation on whether billing will be via GCP Marketplace (private offer) or direct Redwood invoice (we prefer Marketplace if possible).
- A draft of the private offer so legal can pre-check terms.

Our procurement window is Dec 6–10; if we can align on a clear path this week, I think we can close before year-end. I attached our standard PO template (Nimbus_PO_Template.docx) for reference.

Thanks,
Clare
Clare Morris
Head of Platform Partnerships
Nimbus Labs

Attachments: Nimbus_PO_Template.docx (document)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Clare Morris <clare.morris@nimbuslabs.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Nov 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Marketplace evaluation & next steps

Hi Clare — great to hear. I put together a concise MAP and appended a draft of the GCP private offer flow for your procurement/legal team. See attached: Nimbus_MAP_v3.xlsx and GCP_Private_Offer_Draft.pdf.

High level MAP (dates are target, editable):
- 11/29: Exchange final billing entity details & TAX ID (Nimbus)
- 12/01: Redwood sends private offer to Nimbus (GCP marketplace link) + internal invoice routing notes
- 12/03: Nimbus review + PO issuance
- 12/06: Accept private offer in GCP console; provisioning window opens 12/07–12/10
- 12/15: Go-live on committed capacity (reserved GPU pool)

Two quick clarifications for procurement:
1) Billing path: we recommend accepting the private offer in GCP Marketplace — this lets billing flow through Google and gated invoices appear on your next cloud bill. If Nimbus needs a Redwood direct invoice instead, we can accommodate with our finance team but it typically pushes the approval path by ~3–5 business days.
2) Contracting: the private offer acceptance is the commercial commitment; we ship a DocuSign for the underlying terms (standard SOW/cancellations) concurrently so legal can sign in parallel.

Ben — can you confirm the exact billing code and invoice recipient details we should include in the offer?

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Nimbus_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), GCP_Private_Offer_Draft.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Clare Morris <clare.morris@nimbuslabs.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Marketplace evaluation & next steps

Clare / team — copying billing/ops notes into thread.

Billing routing options (choose one):
A) GCP Marketplace (recommended):
   - Accept private offer via GCP link (we prepare offer with SKUs + committed spend).
   - Invoices appear on Nimbus's GCP invoice; Google collects & remits to Redwood.
   - You should provide: billing entity name, billing contact email, TAX ID/EIN, and preferred invoice PO number prefix.

B) Redwood direct invoicing:
   - Redwood issues monthly invoice to Nimbus. Our finance team needs PO, remit-to address, and W-9 equivalent; payment terms net 30 by default.
   - This option may require an additional finance review and possibly a short master subscription amendment.

For the private offer we will:
- Populate the offer with the committed monthly credits and SKU mapping (reserve capacity product).
- Include the billing contact and PO# field so procurement can attach the PO.

Suggested billing fields to provide to us ASAP:
- Legal entity name (exact): Nimbus Labs, Inc.
- Billing contact: procurement@nimbuslabs.ai
- TAX ID / EIN: 12-3456789
- PO prefix (if used): NIM-PO-

Once we have those, I will send the private offer link and a short acceptance checklist.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Lead, Cloud Marketplace Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: internal-billing-guidelines.txt (referenced)

From: procurement@nimbuslabs.ai

Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Marketplace evaluation & next steps

Ben / Soojin,

Thanks for the clear options. We confirm preference A (GCP Marketplace private offer). A few items from our procurement checklist to finalize acceptance:
- Please confirm Redwood's remit-to entity and VAT/tax details for our records.
- Attach the exact SKU mapping and committed spend monthly cadence (we need line-item detail for our internal PO).
- Legal would like to review the DocuSign envelope for the commercial terms before the private offer is accepted (can be redlines in parallel).

Timeline note: our internal approvers will sign off on a PO on 12/03 if all billing/legal artifacts are available by COB 12/02. Otherwise we push to the next approval window 12/09–12/10.

Attached is our PO template again for signature.

Procurement Team
Nimbus Labs
